templateSource: Blood is blood. Whatever happened tonight, make sure #targetName# is not the one voted guilty.
templateTarget: Blood is blood. Whatever happened tonight, make sure #targetName# is not the one voted guilty.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# was not voted guilty and #ownerName# spoke up for them at least once.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# was not voted guilty and #ownerName# spoke up for them at least once.

templateSource: Family should not keep secrets. Get #targetName# to tell you one true thing they have been hiding from you.
templateTarget: #targetName# is family, which is exactly why they cannot know your business. Tell them nothing true about yourself tonight.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# admitted something real to #ownerName#.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# gave #targetName# no real information about themselves all night.

templateSource: Old loyalties still count. The first time someone goes after #targetName# tonight, back them up in front of everyone.
templateTarget: Old loyalties still count. The first time someone goes after #targetName# tonight, back them up in front of everyone.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# publicly defended #targetName# at least once.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# publicly defended #targetName# at least once.

templateSource: #targetName# still owes you from the old days. Get them to settle up tonight: eddies, a favor, or a public thank-you.
templateTarget: #targetName# thinks you owe them for the old days. Leave tonight without paying them a single eddie or favor.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# paid #ownerName# in any form.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# gave #targetName# nothing.

templateSource: The partnership ended badly. Get #targetName# to admit, in front of someone else, that the split was their fault.
templateTarget: The partnership ended badly. Get #targetName# to admit, in front of someone else, that the split was their fault.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# took the blame in front of a witness.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# took the blame in front of a witness.

templateSource: You and #targetName# were good together once. Close one deal tonight with a third guest, working as a team.
templateTarget: You and #targetName# were good together once. Close one deal tonight with a third guest, working as a team.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# and #targetName# jointly struck any deal with another player.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# and #targetName# jointly struck any deal with another player.

templateSource: You barely know #targetName#. Fix that: learn one thing about them tonight that they would not want repeated.
templateTarget: You barely know #targetName#. Fix that: learn one thing about them tonight that they would not want repeated.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# can tell the GM one real secret or embarrassing fact about #targetName#.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# can tell the GM one real secret or embarrassing fact about #targetName#.

templateSource: You need someone respectable in your corner. Get #targetName# to vouch for you in front of the group.
templateTarget: #targetName# keeps dropping your name as if you were close. Do not vouch for them tonight, no matter how they ask.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# publicly vouched for #ownerName#.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# never vouched for #targetName#.

templateSource: You have another job for #targetName#. Get them to agree to it tonight, at the old rate.
templateTarget: #targetName# never paid what the last job was worth. Get what you are owed tonight, or refuse in public to ever work for them again.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# agreed to work for #ownerName# again without a raise.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# got paid by #targetName#, or publicly cut ties with them.

templateSource: #targetName# is your hire, and your liability. Make sure nobody pins tonight on them.
templateTarget: #targetName# signs your checks. Make sure they walk out of here without cuffs on.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# was not voted guilty and #ownerName# defended them at least once.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# was not voted guilty and #ownerName# defended them at least once.

templateSource: Find out who else #targetName# has been taking jobs from. You paid for loyalty and you want to know if you got it.
templateTarget: Your other clients are none of #targetName#'s business. Do not let them learn who else you have worked for.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# learned the name of another of #targetName#'s clients.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# never learned who else #ownerName# works for.

templateSource: Your arrangement with #targetName# has to hold. Get them to confirm, privately, that they will keep looking the other way.
templateTarget: You want out. End the arrangement with #targetName# tonight, and make them accept it.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# agreed to keep the arrangement going.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# ended the arrangement and #targetName# acknowledged it.

templateSource: #targetName# is getting expensive. Leave tonight paying them no more than you already do.
templateTarget: Looking away just got riskier. Squeeze a bigger cut out of #targetName# before the night ends.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# did not agree to pay #targetName# more.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# agreed to pay #ownerName# more.

templateSource: Nobody learns about the money between you and #targetName#. If anyone asks, you barely know each other.
templateTarget: Nobody learns about the money between you and #targetName#. If anyone asks, you barely know each other.
hintSource: Award if the arrangement between #ownerName# and #targetName# was never revealed to the group.
hintTarget: Award if the arrangement between #ownerName# and #targetName# was never revealed to the group.

templateSource: You taught #targetName# everything they know. Keep them out of the fallout tonight.
templateTarget: You owe #targetName# your career. Defend them the first time someone accuses them.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# shielded #targetName# from suspicion at least once.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# publicly defended #targetName# at least once.

templateSource: #targetName# still needs you, whether they admit it or not. Get them to ask for your advice in front of others.
templateTarget: You have outgrown #targetName#. Contradict or overrule them in public at least once tonight.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# openly asked #ownerName# for advice or help.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# publicly contradicted #targetName# and did not back down.

templateSource: Collect from #targetName# tonight: a payment, a favor, or a promise made in front of a witness.
templateTarget: Get out from under #targetName#. Leave tonight having paid them nothing.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# paid #ownerName# in any form.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# gave #targetName# nothing all night.

templateSource: Your hold on #targetName# only works in the dark. Make sure the group never learns you are squeezing them.
templateTarget: Turn the tables. Get someone else in this house to lean on #targetName# for you.
hintSource: Award if the blackmail was never revealed to the group.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# recruited another player against #targetName#.

templateSource: Come out of tonight looking better than #targetName#. Get at least one guest to side with you against them openly.
templateTarget: Come out of tonight looking better than #targetName#. Get at least one guest to side with you against them openly.
hintSource: Award if a third player openly took #ownerName#'s side against #targetName#.
hintTarget: Award if a third player openly took #ownerName#'s side against #targetName#.

templateSource: Make #targetName# back down from you in public at least once tonight.
templateTarget: Make #targetName# back down from you in public at least once tonight.
hintSource: Award if #targetName# visibly conceded an argument or a standoff to #ownerName#.
hintTarget: Award if #targetName# visibly conceded an argument or a standoff to #ownerName#.

templateSource: #targetName# was not here for the canapes. Find out what they wanted from #victimName#.
templateTarget: #targetName# was not here for the canapes. Find out what they wanted from #victimName#.
hintSource: Award if #ownerName# can tell the GM #targetName#'s real connection to the victim.
hintTarget: Award if #ownerName# can tell the GM #targetName#'s real connection to the victim.
